- graphify: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

55	func (s *APIV1Service) ListUsers(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListUsersRequest) (*v1pb.ListUsersResponse, error) {
56		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user: %v", err)
59		}
60		if currentUser == nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62		}
63		if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
64			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65		}
66	
67		userFind := &store.FindUser{}
68	
69		if request.Filter != "" {
70			username, err := extractUsernameFromFilter(request.Filter)
71			if err != nil {
72				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
73			}
74			if username != "" {
75				userFind.Username = &username
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var limit, offset int
80		if request.PageToken != "" {
81			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
82			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
83				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
84			}
85			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
86			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
87		} else {
88			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
89		}
90		// Fetch one extra row to detect whether a subsequent page exists.
91		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
92		userFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
93		userFind.Offset = &offset
94	
95		users, err := s.Store.ListUsers(ctx, userFind)
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list users: %v", err)
98		}
99	
100		nextPageToken := ""
101		if len(users) == limitPlusOne {
102			users = users[:limit]
103			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
104			if err != nil {
105				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token: %v", err)
106			}
107		}
108	
109		response := &v1pb.ListUsersResponse{
110			Users:         make([]*v1pb.User, 0, len(users)),
111			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
112		}
113		for _, user := range users {
114			response.Users = append(response.Users, convertUserFromStore(user, currentUser))
115		}
116		return response, nil
117	}

119	func normalizeBatchUsernames(usernames []string) ([]string, int) {
120		uniqueUsernames := make([]string, 0, len(usernames))
121		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(usernames))
122		nonEmptyCount := 0
123		for _, username := range usernames {
124			username = strings.TrimSpace(username)
125			if username == "" {
126				continue
127			}
128			nonEmptyCount++
129			if _, ok := seen[username]; ok {
130				continue
131			}
132			seen[username] = struct{}{}
133			uniqueUsernames = append(uniqueUsernames, username)
134		}
135		return uniqueUsernames, nonEmptyCount
136	}

183	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateUser(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateUserRequest) (*v1pb.User, error) {
184		// Get current user (might be nil for unauthenticated requests)
185		currentUser, _ := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
186	
187		if request.User == nil {
188			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "user is required")
189		}
190		if err := validateWritableUsername(request.User.Username); err != nil {
191			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid username: %s", request.User.Username)
192		}
193		if err := validatePassword(request.User.Password); err != nil {
194			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%v", err)
195		}
196	
197		roleToAssign := store.RoleUser
198		if currentUser != nil && currentUser.Role == store.RoleAdmin {
199			// Authenticated ADMIN user can create users with any role specified in request
200			if request.User.Role != v1pb.User_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED {
201				roleToAssign = convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
202			}
203		} else {
204			limitOne := 1
205			allUsers, err := s.Store.ListUsers(ctx, &store.FindUser{Limit: &limitOne})
206			if err != nil {
207				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list users: %v", err)
208			}
209			if len(allUsers) == 0 {
210				roleToAssign = store.RoleAdmin
211				if !request.ValidateOnly {
212					passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
213					if err != nil {
214						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
215					}
216					user, created, err := s.Store.CreateUserIfNoUsers(ctx, &store.User{
217						Username:     request.User.Username,
218						Role:         store.RoleAdmin,
219						Email:        request.User.Email,
220						Nickname:     request.User.DisplayName,
221						PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
222					})
223					if err != nil {
224						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create first user: %v", err)
225					}
226					if created {
227						return convertUserFromStore(user, user), nil
228					}
229					roleToAssign = store.RoleUser
230				}
231			}
232	
233			// Only allow user registration if it is enabled in the settings, or if the user is a superuser
234			if roleToAssign != store.RoleAdmin {
235				instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
236				if err != nil {
237					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
238				}
239				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
240					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
241				}
242				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth {
243					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signup is not allowed")
244				}
245			}
246		}
247	
248		// If validate_only is true, just validate without creating
249		if request.ValidateOnly {
250			// Perform validation checks without actually creating the user
251			return &v1pb.User{
252				Username:    request.User.Username,
253				Email:       request.User.Email,
254				DisplayName: request.User.DisplayName,
255				Role:        convertUserRoleFromStore(roleToAssign),
256			}, nil
257		}
258	
259		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
260		if err != nil {
261			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
262		}
263	
264		user, err := s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
265			Username:     request.User.Username,
266			Role:         roleToAssign,
267			Email:        request.User.Email,
268			Nickname:     request.User.DisplayName,
269			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
270		})
271		if err != nil {
272			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user: %v", err)
273		}
274	
275		return convertUserFromStore(user, user), nil
276	}

283			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "update mask is empty")

285		user, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, request.User.Name)
286		if err != nil {

289		if user == nil {

295		userID := user.ID

297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user: %v", err)
299		}
300		if currentUser == nil {
301			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
302		}
303		// Check permission.
304		// Only allow admin or self to update user.
305		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
306			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
307		}
308	
309		currentTs := time.Now().Unix()
310		update := &store.UpdateUser{
311			ID:        user.ID,
312			UpdatedTs: &currentTs,
313		}
314		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting: %v", err)
317		}
318		for _, field := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
319			switch field {
320			case "username":
321				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowChangeUsername {
322					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied: disallow change username")
323				}
324				if err := validateWritableUsername(request.User.Username); err != nil {
325					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid username: %s", request.User.Username)
326				}
327				update.Username = &request.User.Username
328			case "display_name":
329				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowChangeNickname {
330					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied: disallow change nickname")
331				}
332				update.Nickname = &request.User.DisplayName
333			case "email":
334				update.Email = &request.User.Email
335			case "avatar_url":
336				// Validate avatar MIME type to prevent XSS during upload
337				if request.User.AvatarUrl != "" {
338					imageType, _, err := extractImageInfo(request.User.AvatarUrl)
339					if err != nil {
340						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar format: %v", err)
341					}
342					// Only allow safe image formats for avatars
343					allowedAvatarTypes := map[string]bool{
344						"image/png":  true,
345						"image/jpeg": true,
346						"image/jpg":  true,
347						"image/gif":  true,
348						"image/webp": true,
349					}
350					if !allowedAvatarTypes[imageType] {
351						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar image type: %s. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP are allowed", imageType)
352					}
353				}
354				update.AvatarURL = &request.User.AvatarUrl
355			case "description":
356				update.Description = &request.User.Description
357			case "role":
358				// Only allow admin to update role.
359				if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
360					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
361				}
362				role := convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
363				update.Role = &role
364			case "password":
365				if err := validatePassword(request.User.Password); err != nil {
366					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%v", err)
367				}
368				passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
369				if err != nil {
370					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
371				}
372				passwordHashStr := string(passwordHash)
373				update.PasswordHash = &passwordHashStr
374			case "state":
375				if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
376					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
377				}
378				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.User.State)
379				update.RowStatus = &rowStatus
380			default:
381				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid update path: %s", field)
382			}
383		}
384	
385		updatedUser, err := s.Store.UpdateUser(ctx, update)
386		if err != nil {
387			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update user: %v", err)
388		}
389	
390		return convertUserFromStore(updatedUser, currentUser), nil
391	}

451			)
452		}

55	func (s *APIV1Service) ListUsers(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListUsersRequest) (*v1pb.ListUsersResponse, error) {
56		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user: %v", err)
59		}
60		if currentUser == nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62		}
63		if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
64			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65		}
66	
67		userFind := &store.FindUser{}
68	
69		if request.Filter != "" {
70			username, err := extractUsernameFromFilter(request.Filter)
71			if err != nil {
72				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
73			}
74			if username != "" {
75				userFind.Username = &username
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var limit, offset int
80		if request.PageToken != "" {
81			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
82			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
83				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
84			}
85			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
86			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
87		} else {
88			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
89		}
90		// Fetch one extra row to detect whether a subsequent page exists.
91		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
92		userFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
93		userFind.Offset = &offset
94	
95		users, err := s.Store.ListUsers(ctx, userFind)
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list users: %v", err)
98		}
99	
100		nextPageToken := ""
101		if len(users) == limitPlusOne {
102			users = users[:limit]
103			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
104			if err != nil {
105				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token: %v", err)
106			}
107		}
108	
109		response := &v1pb.ListUsersResponse{
110			Users:         make([]*v1pb.User, 0, len(users)),

112		}

119	func normalizeBatchUsernames(usernames []string) ([]string, int) {
120		uniqueUsernames := make([]string, 0, len(usernames))
121		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(usernames))
122		nonEmptyCount := 0
123		for _, username := range usernames {
124			username = strings.TrimSpace(username)
125			if username == "" {
126				continue
127			}
128			nonEmptyCount++
129			if _, ok := seen[username]; ok {
130				continue
131			}
132			seen[username] = struct{}{}
133			uniqueUsernames = append(uniqueUsernames, username)
134		}
135		return uniqueUsernames, nonEmptyCount
136	}

183	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateUser(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateUserRequest) (*v1pb.User, error) {
184		// Get current user (might be nil for unauthenticated requests)
185		currentUser, _ := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
186	
187		if request.User == nil {
188			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "user is required")
189		}
190		if err := validateWritableUsername(request.User.Username); err != nil {
191			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid username: %s", request.User.Username)
192		}
193		if err := validatePassword(request.User.Password); err != nil {
194			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%v", err)
195		}
196	
197		roleToAssign := store.RoleUser
198		if currentUser != nil && currentUser.Role == store.RoleAdmin {
199			// Authenticated ADMIN user can create users with any role specified in request
200			if request.User.Role != v1pb.User_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED {
201				roleToAssign = convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
202			}
203		} else {
204			limitOne := 1
205			allUsers, err := s.Store.ListUsers(ctx, &store.FindUser{Limit: &limitOne})
206			if err != nil {
207				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list users: %v", err)
208			}
209			if len(allUsers) == 0 {
210				roleToAssign = store.RoleAdmin
211				if !request.ValidateOnly {
212					passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
213					if err != nil {
214						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
215					}
216					user, created, err := s.Store.CreateUserIfNoUsers(ctx, &store.User{
217						Username:     request.User.Username,
218						Role:         store.RoleAdmin,
219						Email:        request.User.Email,
220						Nickname:     request.User.DisplayName,
221						PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
222					})
223					if err != nil {
224						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create first user: %v", err)
225					}
226					if created {
227						return convertUserFromStore(user, user), nil
228					}
229					roleToAssign = store.RoleUser
230				}
231			}
232	
233			// Only allow user registration if it is enabled in the settings, or if the user is a superuser
234			if roleToAssign != store.RoleAdmin {
235				instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
236				if err != nil {
237					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
238				}
239				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
240					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
241				}
242				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth {
243					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signup is not allowed")
244				}
245			}
246		}
247	
248		// If validate_only is true, just validate without creating
249		if request.ValidateOnly {
250			// Perform validation checks without actually creating the user
251			return &v1pb.User{
252				Username:    request.User.Username,
253				Email:       request.User.Email,
254				DisplayName: request.User.DisplayName,
255				Role:        convertUserRoleFromStore(roleToAssign),
256			}, nil
257		}
258	
259		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
260		if err != nil {
261			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
262		}
263	
264		user, err := s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
265			Username:     request.User.Username,
266			Role:         roleToAssign,
267			Email:        request.User.Email,
268			Nickname:     request.User.DisplayName,
269			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
270		})
271		if err != nil {
272			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user: %v", err)
273		}
274	
275		return convertUserFromStore(user, user), nil
276	}

283			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "update mask is empty")

285		user, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, request.User.Name)
286		if err != nil {

289		if user == nil {

291				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "user not found")
292			}
293			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "user not found")
294		}
295		userID := user.ID
296		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user: %v", err)
299		}
300		if currentUser == nil {
301			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
302		}
303		// Check permission.
304		// Only allow admin or self to update user.
305		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
306			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
307		}
308	
309		currentTs := time.Now().Unix()
310		update := &store.UpdateUser{
311			ID:        user.ID,
312			UpdatedTs: &currentTs,
313		}
314		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting: %v", err)
317		}
318		for _, field := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
319			switch field {
320			case "username":
321				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowChangeUsername {
322					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied: disallow change username")
323				}
324				if err := validateWritableUsername(request.User.Username); err != nil {
325					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid username: %s", request.User.Username)
326				}
327				update.Username = &request.User.Username
328			case "display_name":
329				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowChangeNickname {
330					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied: disallow change nickname")
331				}
332				update.Nickname = &request.User.DisplayName
333			case "email":
334				update.Email = &request.User.Email
335			case "avatar_url":
336				// Validate avatar MIME type to prevent XSS during upload
337				if request.User.AvatarUrl != "" {
338					imageType, _, err := extractImageInfo(request.User.AvatarUrl)
339					if err != nil {
340						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar format: %v", err)
341					}
342					// Only allow safe image formats for avatars
343					allowedAvatarTypes := map[string]bool{
344						"image/png":  true,
345						"image/jpeg": true,
346						"image/jpg":  true,
347						"image/gif":  true,
348						"image/webp": true,
349					}
350					if !allowedAvatarTypes[imageType] {
351						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar image type: %s. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP are allowed", imageType)
352					}
353				}
354				update.AvatarURL = &request.User.AvatarUrl
355			case "description":
356				update.Description = &request.User.Description
357			case "role":
358				// Only allow admin to update role.
359				if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
360					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
361				}
362				role := convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
363				update.Role = &role
364			case "password":
365				if err := validatePassword(request.User.Password); err != nil {
366					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%v", err)
367				}
368				passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
369				if err != nil {
370					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
371				}
372				passwordHashStr := string(passwordHash)
373				update.PasswordHash = &passwordHashStr
374			case "state":
375				if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
376					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
377				}
378				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.User.State)
379				update.RowStatus = &rowStatus
380			default:
381				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid update path: %s", field)
382			}
383		}
384	
385		updatedUser, err := s.Store.UpdateUser(ctx, update)
386		if err != nil {
387			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update user: %v", err)
388		}
389	
390		return convertUserFromStore(updatedUser, currentUser), nil
391	}

450				attachmentCleanupErr,
451			)
452		}
